question: Which of the following groups of metals are so soft that they can be cut with a knife and have low densities and low melting points?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lithium, Sodium, or Indium.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• **Melting and Boiling Points:**
 
• **Essence has high melting and boiling points. **
 
• 
 
Tungsten actually has one of the highest melting points of all elements, not the lowest. It melts at around 3422°C (6192°F). Its boiling point is also very high, at about 5555°C (10031°F).

 
On the other hand, mercury has one of the lowest melting points of all metallic elements, melting at -38.83°C (-37.89°F). Its boiling point, however, is not the lowest; it boils at 356.73°C

 
 
• **Sodium and potassium also have low melting points. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The melting point of a pure substance is always advanced and has a lower range than the melting point of an impure substance or, more generally, of fusions. The more advanced the volume of other factors, the lower the melting point and the broader will be the melting point range, frequently appertained to as the" doughy range". 
 
• **Lithium, Sodium, and Potassium essence **are soft because the cohesive forces between these essences are veritably weak, therefore these essences have a soft texture and are fluently cut with a cutter. 
 
• **Essence like Gold and Iron is hard and thick.** They're malleable and ductile. They're veritably tough and it's nearly insolvable to be cut with a cutter. 
 
• **If an object is light for its size it has a low viscosity**. A pebble is heavy for its size, compared to a piece of popcorn which is light for it's size.
